label: 1-second OHLC research simulation; not NT-native executable validation
filter_status: unchanged from prior established-regime study; causal and direction-symmetric
weakness_trigger: first strict crossing from below the frozen direction-specific W4 threshold while the established filter is true
entry: fade prevailing direction at the first available raw 1-second ts_event open at or after the causal decision boundary
stop_fill: bar open when the bar gaps through the stop; otherwise stop price when the 1-second OHLC range reaches it
exit: hold through the first flip aligning with the countertrade; exit at the next available 1-second open at or after the following flip against the countertrade
same_bar_rule: scheduled flip exit fills at its decision-boundary open before that bar range; stop is evaluated on prior bars including the entry bar
overlap_rule: one position at a time; after a stop touch, no entry is allowed at that same 1-second bar open
